description: Drag one element onto another: press on the first, move to the second in small steps, and let go. For reordering lists and boards, moving cards between columns, and the like. Works with the browser's own drag and drop and with pages that follow the mouse themselves, and scrolls while holding the item if the drop target is out of sight. Name each end by its ref from browser_snapshot, or else by the text it shows. Says what moved where when the page shows it; take a new snapshot to check the result.

fromRef.description: Ref of the element to drag, from browser_snapshot, e.g. e123.

fromText.description: Instead of fromRef: the visible text of the element to drag.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

toRef.description: Ref of the element to drop it on, from browser_snapshot.

toText.description: Instead of toRef: the visible text of the element to drop it on.

name: browser_drag
